display_name: Lei de Introdução às normas do Direito Brasileiro (Decreto-Lei 4.657/1942), legalese-sonnet-5.5
scope: Encoded: all 30 articles of the compiled text deposited as ../../registers/source-bundle/lindb-1942.pt.txt (art. 1 commencement with its own-provision, place and correction rules; the counting of periods as far as the text speaks; arts. 2 to 6 on the life of a law; arts. 7 to 19 on private international law and consular acts; arts. 20 to 30 on public-law decision making). Not encoded: art. 1 par. 2, art. 15 sole paragraph, art. 23 sole paragraph, art. 25, art. 26 par. 1 II and par. 2, art. 28 pars. 1 to 3, art. 29 par. 2 (repealed or vetoed in the text); art. 26 par. 1 I and art. 30 caput (aims or duties with no test). Where the text is silent (general counting of periods, rest days, holidays and recess, deemed service, weeks, the moment of day a law binds, subordinate legislation, the meaning of time words, repeal and re-enactment) the encoding gives a named REFUSE, never a default. See NOTES.md section 5 for the row-by-row coverage table.
